updates.title: Pilot for Online Version of Application for a U.S. Passport (Form DS-11)
updates.summary: The Department of State is announcing a pilot program to accept certain renewal and first-time passport applications online. Interested applicants will be able to visit America.gov to check their eligibility to submit a passport application through this pilot. It is anticipated that the pool of eligible applicants will be expanded as testing progresses.

updates.title: Safety Zone; Huron River, Huron, OH
updates.summary: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters of the Huron River within a 150-yard radius of 41[deg]23'34.6" N, 82[deg]33'07.7" W in Huron, OH. The safety zone is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards created by an over water fireworks show. updates.title: Notice of Request for Approval of a New Information Collection; Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza: Administration of Vaccine in Zoos
updates.summary: In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, this notice announces the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service's intention to request approval of a new information collection for implementation of vaccination for highly pathogenic avian influenza in zoos and animal sanctuaries.

updates.title: Record of Decision; Temporary Closure of East Potomac Park South of Buckeye Drive
updates.summary: The National Park Service (NPS) will temporarily close to public access and use all federal parkland administered by the National Mall and Memorial Parks within East Potomac Park south of Buckeye Drive SW, including East Potomac Golf Course.

updates.title: Privacy of Consumer Financial Information
updates.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is issuing a final rule to make technical corrections to provisions of the NCUA's regulations. The technical amendments improve clarity by removing obsolete references to the privacy of consumer financial information regulation, which the NCUA no longer administers.
